scripts.install:hc: bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh holochain $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh hc $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh kitsune2-bootstrap-srv $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_k2_version
scripts.extract:localize: npm run localize:extract -w webcomponents && npm run localize:extract -w webapp
scripts.build:localize: npm run localize:build -w webcomponents && npm run localize:build -w webapp
scripts.build:zomes: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:dna: npm run build:zomes && mkdir -p artifacts && $npm_package_config_bin/hc dna pack -o artifacts/files.dna dna/workdir
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:dna && $npm_package_config_bin/hc app pack -o artifacts/files.happ dna/workdir && bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh
scripts.build:devtest: npm run clean:hc & npm run build:happ
scripts.build:webapp: node scripts/generate-version.js && npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run build -w webapp
scripts.devtest:quick: UI_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run build -w webapp" "npm run start:mem"
scripts.devtest: npm run build:devtest && npm run build:webapp && npm run start:mem
scripts.devtest:we: npm run build:devtest && npm run build:webapp && npm run devtest -w we-applet
scripts.devtest:we:block: npm run build:devtest && npm run devtest:block -w we-applet
scripts.prodtest: npm run build -w webapp &&  UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run build:watch -w webcomponents" "npm run new-sandbox:mem" "sleep 7 && npm run start -w webapp"
scripts.prodtestfull:we: npm run build:devtest && npm run build:webapp && npm run dist:we && npm run prodtest:we
scripts.prodtest:we: BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:run" "npm run prodtest:we-launch"
scripts.multiagentall: concurrently "npm run multiagent" "sleep 5 && npm run multiagent2" "sleep 7 && npm run multiagent3"
scripts.start:mem: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=debug FORCE_COLOR=0 UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run new-sandbox:mem" "sleep 5 && npm run start -w webapp"
scripts.start:local: FORCE_COLOR=0 UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run _save-ports" "npm run new-sandbox:local" "sleep 5 && npm run start -w webapp"
scripts.new-sandbox:mem: echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/files.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a Files network mem
scripts.new-sandbox:local: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/files.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a Files network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT
scripts.serve:save: echo SIGNAL_PORT=$SIGNAL_PORT && echo $SIGNAL_PORT > .hc_signalenv && echo $BOOT_PORT > .hc_bootenv && echo BOOT_PORT=$BOOT_PORT
scripts.network2: npm run build:devtest && FORCE_COLOR=0 BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:save" "npm run serve:run" "INDEX=0 npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && INDEX=1 npm run start:local"
scripts.network3: npm run build:devtest && FORCE_COLOR=0 BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:save" "npm run serve:run" "INDEX=0 npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && INDEX=1 npm run start:local" "sleep 2 && INDEX=2 npm run start:local"
scripts.network:we: npm run clean:hc & npm run network:local2 -w we-applet
scripts.local:sandbox: echo INDEX $INDEX & echo PORTS $BOOT_PORT $SIGNAL_PORT $HC_APP_PORT $HC_ADMIN_PORT & RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT run $INDEX
scripts._local: BOOT_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) SIGNAL_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) HC_APP_PORT=$(cat .hc_app_$INDEX) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(cat .hc_admin_$INDEX) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run local:sandbox" "sleep 7 && npm run start -w webapp"
scripts.launch: HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) echo pass | hc-launch --piped -n 1 artifacts/files.webhapp network mem
scripts.launch:we: echo pass | hc-launch --piped -n 1 artifacts/files-we_applet.webhapp network mem
scripts.package:webapp: rm -rf artifacts/files-webapp-ui.zip && npm run build -w webapp && cd webapp/dist && rm -f *.map && bestzip ../../artifacts/files-webapp-ui.zip * && cd ../../ && $npm_package_config_bin/hc web-app pack webapp/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/files.webhapp
scripts.package:we: rm -rf artifacts/files-we_applet-ui.zip & cd we-applet/dist && rm -f *.map && bestzip ../../artifacts/files-we_applet-ui.zip * && cd ../../ && $npm_package_config_bin/hc web-app pack we-applet/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/files-we_applet.webhapp
scripts.dist:we: npm run dist -w we-applet && npm run package:we
scripts.dl-manual-release: rm -rf release & mkdir -p release & gh release download manual-release -D release -R lightningrodlabs/files
scripts.dl-applet-release: rm -rf release & mkdir -p release & gh release download we-applet-rc -D release -R lightningrodlabs/files
scripts.repackage:we: rm -rf artifacts && mkdir artifacts && cp release/files.happ artifacts && npm run dist:we && npm run hash
scripts.upload:we: cp artifacts/files-we_applet.webhapp artifacts/files-we_applet-$npm_package_version.webhapp && gh release upload we-applet-rc artifacts/files-we_applet-$npm_package_version.webhapp
scripts.reupload:we: npm run dl-applet-release && npm run unpack:webhapp && npm run repackage:we && npm run upload:we
